description: Markdown editing add-in for Microsoft OneNote desktop.
pre_install: if (Get-Process ONENOTE -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { throw 'Close OneNote before installing OneMark.' }

script: if (!$modified.GenerateTransform($original, $transform)) { throw 'Could not generate the OneMark per-user transform.' }
if (!(Invoke-ExternalCommand msiexec.exe -ArgumentList $arguments -ContinueExitCodes @{3010 = 'Restart Windows to complete installation.'})) { throw 'OneMark MSI installation failed.' }

pre_uninstall: if (Get-Process ONENOTE -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { throw 'Close OneNote before uninstalling OneMark.' }

script: if (!(Invoke-ExternalCommand msiexec.exe -ArgumentList $arguments -ContinueExitCodes @{1605 = 'OneMark is already uninstalled.'; 3010 = 'Restart Windows to complete uninstallation.'})) { throw 'OneMark MSI uninstallation failed.' }

notes: Requires 64-bit Microsoft OneNote desktop and .NET Framework 4.5 or later. Installs for the current user by default; use -g from an elevated PowerShell for a machine-wide installation. Close OneNote before installation or removal. Per-user installation applies a transform to register the add-in under the current user's registry.
